/poll question: Gaseous Form changes / Spectre Form by Erik Helson
text:
Author: Erik Helson
Post: https://discord.com/channels/766364534495117383/1286801164326797385/1529505027364880607
Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1zFeAPxkCGukONf6WDtnVJDGgyRWFN15C0CiTgiugL0s/edit?usp=drivesdk
Summary:
- Renames Gaseous Form to Spectre Form; hood letter changes from G to S.
- Adds melee combat between Spectre Form and Shadow Walk participants.
- Normal armor and combat rules apply between them, but spells and skills remain barred while in form.
- Interacting with the physical world still breaks the spell.
answer-1: Yes
answer-2: No
answer-3: Abstain
name: Gaseous Form changes / Spectre Form
notes: Author renamed the proposal after August 8 Senate feedback (originally framed as Gaseous Form changes).
